verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no way to turn an OpenAPI definition or custom code into a hosted MCP server. Smithery's build docs cover publishing a server that is already deployed elsewhere via its URL, distributing pre-built MCPB bundles for local stdio servers, and exposing a self-run server through Uplink. All of these assume the developer has already built the MCP server. The October 2026 shutdown notice also says Smithery now remains only as a public, non-proxied registry.

support.subject: As a developer, I can turn an existing API definition (OpenAPI) or custom code into a hosted MCP server without writing protocol plumbing
